premises: One fixed deterministic digest function; no injectivity or cryptographic-strength axiom.
Exact plaintext/token identity and a partial single-valued vault map.
Enrollment succeeds only when the token is absent or maps to exactly the proposed plaintext.
Success stores that mapping atomically; failed transactions leave no committed effect.
Only the modeled enrollments mutate this state; excluded-owner/key/custody changes are outside the model.
scope: Two successful enrollments preserve an unambiguous token mapping, including arbitrary modeled digest collisions. No actual HMAC collision is produced. Native SQL, role ACLs, atomicity, lifecycle, algorithms, key/vault custody and propagation are not proved.
